instruction: Adjust Chrome's default font size to 12px so that more text fits on the screen.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting default font size in Chrome to exactly 12 pixels for compact text display. Evaluator checks if default_font_size == 12. Uses custom getter to extract default_font_size from Chrome preferences and custom metric to validate the exact value.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads Chrome default font size from webkit.webprefs.default_font_size in preferences file
Metric correctly performs exact equality check (default_font_size == 12) as required by instruction
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure preferences are reloaded for verification
Complete coverage: single requirement (set font size to 12 pixels) is fully verified
Correct expected parameter handling: metric directly accesses rules dict fields (expected['type'], expected['value'])
Robust error handling: getter returns default value (16) on error to prevent crashes
No stale state issues: preferences persisted to disk and Chrome restart ensures fresh read
